svg.text: Apple's rear strip: no components (16 mm); this card's edge is at 21 mm
Pi 3A+ (components down, 8.5 mm above the card; top at 9.9 mm)
Aurora68 Card P (draft): top view as Apple's Figure 17-1. Front of the SE at the bottom, rear at the top; the slot plug J1 (purple, underside) at the right.
Blue dashed: Apple's height limit (Fig. 17-2), 4.61 mm at the rear edge to 15.58 mm at the front. Orange: keep-outs under the Pi's parts; red: the Pi 3B/3B+ USB and Ethernet keep-out.
All layers: red L1 (top), blue L4 (bottom); L2 ground and L3 +3.3 V planes in img/board-L2.png, board-L3.png. Generated by tools/render.py from aurora68-card-p.kicad_pcb.
